description:
Nak-Won, who entered the prestigious private school Soran High School, feels her heart flutter on her first day when she encounters the student body president, Yo-Han. Soon after, she hears news that Yo-Han is studying abroad in the United States. Nak-Won decides to follow him there. To earn money for her plane ticket, she hatches a bold and endearing plan... Meanwhile, Jin-Mi, who seems somewhat mysterious, begins to wander around Nak-Won, hoping to befriend her. Each of them embarks on a journey to find their own movie protagonist. What will their final outcome be?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

 *Note: Includes two extra chapters.*
